whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Patliputra Dental Care,

I noticed your clinic has exceptional 4.7★ reviews near Ashok Rajpath in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for instant appointment bookings.

Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, clinic timings, aur services integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/patliputra

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Patliputra Dental Care team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

[If checked:] Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and your clinic location near Ashok Rajpath. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

[If not checked:] No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
